text: Which prostate-specific genes are specific to prostatic glandular cells (single-cell), secreted in the male reproductive tract, stain moderately or strongly in prostate glandular cells, have no detectable mRNA in liver, and are not CD markers?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Prostate / Tissue enriched AND Cell type category (scRNA): Prostatic glandular cells / Cell type enriched AND Secretome annotation: Secreted in male reproductive system AND Tissue expression (IHC): Prostate / glandular cells / Medium, High AND Tissue category (RNA): Liver / Not detected AND NOT Protein class: CD markers
understanding: The query seeks genes defined by prostate tissue specificity at the RNA level, single-cell specificity in prostatic glandular cells, secretome classification in the male reproductive system, moderate or strong IHC staining in prostate glandular cells, absence of detectable mRNA in liver, and exclusion from the CD marker protein class.

trail.why: To filter for prostate-specific genes, the tissue is set to 'prostate' and the category to 'Tissue enriched', which defines mRNA levels at least four-fold higher in that particular tissue compared to any other.

Being 'specific to' a single cell type in the Human Protein Atlas corresponds to the 'Cell type enriched' specificity category, which defines an mRNA level at least four-fold higher in that particular cell type compared to any other.

trail.requirement: secreted in the male reproductive tract
trail.why: The requirement specifies proteins secreted in the male reproductive tract, which directly corresponds to 'Secreted in male reproductive system'.

trail.requirement: stain moderately or strongly in prostate glandular cells
trail.why: Selects prostate tissue, glandular cells, and Medium or High IHC expression to capture moderate or strong staining in prostate glandular cells.

trail.requirement: have no detectable mRNA in liver
trail.why: The requirement specifies no detectable mRNA in liver, which directly matches selecting 'liver' at Level 1 and 'Not detected' at Level 2, defined as mRNA below the detection cut-off of 1 nTPM in the selected tissue.
The filter selects the CD markers class to exclude genes categorized as CD markers, matching requirement r6.

requirements.why: This field classifies genes by RNA specificity across human tissues including prostate.
This field defines RNA specificity and distribution across single-cell types, including 'Prostatic glandular cells'.

requirements.why: This field classifies secreted proteins by destination, including 'Secreted in male reproductive system'.

requirements.requirement: stain moderately or strongly in prostate glandular cells
requirements.why: This field captures immunohistochemistry antibody staining levels (such as Medium and High) per tissue and cell type, including prostate glandular cells.

requirements.requirement: have no detectable mRNA in liver
requirements.why: This field captures RNA specificity and distribution across tissues, including liver-specific expression categories.
This field classifies genes into functional categories including 'CD markers', which must be excluded.
